title: A continuous linear image of an a.e. unit-bounded measurable n-vector field is integrable
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let ν be a finite measure on ℝ^P (Euclid P). Let ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n be ν-a.e. strongly measurable with ‖ξ(x)‖ ≤ 1 for ν-a.e. x, where MultiVector P n = (Covector (Euclid P) n →L[ℝ] ℝ) carries its operator norm. Let J : MultiVector P n →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) n be a continuous linear map. Then x ↦ J(ξ(x)) is ν-integrable (Bochner integrability, with the operator norm on Covector (Euclid P) n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (J : MultiVector P n →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, ‖ξ x‖ ≤ 1) → Integrable (fun x => J (ξ x)) ν
